entries.name: $RESET
entries.purpose: restart the whole system from the Cass? prompt, as at power-on

entries.name: SYNCHK
entries.purpose: check that the byte at HL equals the byte after the call (else syntax error), then advance HL

entries.name: GETPC
entries.purpose: return with the return address in HL, so relocatable code can find where it sits

entries.name: DISKBOOT
entries.purpose: warm restart: reload and run the disk operating system without a full re-initialization

entries.name: NEXTCHAR
entries.purpose: advance HL to the next non-blank BASIC text character; flags show a digit or statement end

entries.name: GETDEV
entries.purpose: read a byte from the device whose control block DE addresses; Z set when it was ready

entries.name: CMPHLDE
entries.purpose: compare HL with DE as unsigned numbers; Z if equal, carry if HL is the smaller

entries.name: PUTDEV
entries.purpose: send the byte in A to the device whose control block DE addresses; Z set when it was ready

entries.name: TESTNTF
entries.purpose: test the number type flag, setting flags that tell a string, integer, single, or double

entries.name: BREAKRST
entries.purpose: jump through the BREAK vector at 400CH, which a DOS also uses for overlay calls

entries.name: $KBCHAR
entries.purpose: scan the keyboard once and return a key if one is down

entries.name: DEBUGRST
entries.purpose: jump through the vector at 400FH, the DEBUG entry under a DOS

entries.name: $VDCHAR
entries.purpose: display the character in A at the cursor

entries.name: INTRST
entries.purpose: maskable interrupt entry, jumping through the vector at 4012H

entries.name: $PRCHAR
entries.purpose: send the character in A to the printer, waiting until it is ready or BREAK is pressed

entries.name: $KBLINE
entries.purpose: read a line from the keyboard into a buffer at HL

entries.name: $KBWAIT
entries.purpose: wait for a key and return it in A

entries.name: $RSRCV
entries.purpose: receive a character from the RS-232-C port; zero means none arrived

entries.name: $RSTX
entries.purpose: send a character to the RS-232-C port

entries.name: $RSINIT
entries.purpose: set up the RS-232-C port from the baud rate, format, and wait switches in RAM

entries.name: $DELAY
entries.purpose: pause for a time set by BC

entries.name: NMIENTRY
entries.purpose: non-maskable interrupt entry, taken when the RESET button is pressed

entries.name: $INITIO
entries.purpose: put every I/O driver and route back to its start-up setting

entries.name: $ROUTE
entries.purpose: reroute one I/O device to another, each named by two letters stored in RAM

entries.name: ERR_L3
entries.purpose: raise the L3 ERROR; the Disk BASIC command vectors, TIME$ aside, jump here until a disk BASIC takes over

entries.name: BASICSET
entries.purpose: entry of the SET statement in BASIC's keyword table

entries.name: BASICRESET
entries.purpose: entry of the RESET statement in BASIC's keyword table

entries.name: PIXELOP
entries.purpose: the SET, RESET, and POINT of BASIC; arguments go on the stack and it is jumped to

entries.name: $VDCLS
entries.purpose: clear the screen

entries.name: $PRSCN
entries.purpose: print the whole screen on the printer

entries.name: $CSOFF
entries.purpose: turn the cassette drive off

entries.name: CASSELECT
entries.purpose: clear A and return; kept so Model I programs that select a cassette drive still run
entries.note: on the Model I this address selects the cassette drive named by A and starts its motor

entries.name: PRTCRRAW
entries.purpose: send a carriage return straight to the printer through $PRCHAR

entries.name: $VDLINE
entries.purpose: display the text at HL up to a carriage return or an ETX

entries.name: BRKTOREADY
entries.purpose: BREAK exit for cassette and RS-232-C waits: enable interrupts and jump to BASIC Ready

entries.name: $CSIN
entries.purpose: read one byte from the cassette into A

entries.name: $CSOUT
entries.purpose: write the byte in A to the cassette

entries.name: $CSHWR
entries.purpose: turn the cassette on and write the leader and sync byte

entries.name: $KBBRK
entries.purpose: check only for BREAK, faster than a full keyboard scan

entries.name: $CSHIN
entries.purpose: turn the cassette on and read up to the leader and sync byte

entries.name: $CLKON
entries.purpose: turn the on-screen clock on

entries.name: $CLKOFF
entries.purpose: turn the on-screen clock off

entries.name: CSINWORD
entries.purpose: read two bytes from the cassette into HL, low byte first

entries.name: OUTCHAR
entries.purpose: send A to the current output device, video, printer, or cassette, as the flag at 409CH says

entries.name: VDCHARCOL
entries.purpose: display A like $VDCHAR, keep DE, and refresh the cursor column that TAB uses

entries.name: CURCOLUMN
entries.purpose: return the cursor column on its line in A

entries.name: KBSAVEDE
entries.purpose: scan the keyboard like $KBCHAR but keep DE

entries.name: KBINBUF
entries.purpose: read a line into the BASIC input buffer, 240 characters at most; carry set if BREAK

entries.name: KBWAITDE
entries.purpose: wait for a key like $KBWAIT but keep DE

entries.name: DEVRESETPRT
entries.purpose: select video output again, first ending a partly printed line on the printer

entries.name: PRTCR
entries.purpose: send a carriage return to the printer, keeping its line-position count

entries.name: PRTCHARPOS
entries.purpose: send A to the printer and track the line position; a line feed goes out as a carriage return

entries.name: PRDRIVER
entries.purpose: the printer driver that the printer control block points to

entries.name: PRTWAIT
entries.purpose: wait for the printer to be ready; on BREAK return to the address pushed before the call

entries.name: PRTTEST
entries.purpose: read the printer status; Z set when it is ready

entries.name: VDDRIVER
entries.purpose: the video driver that the video control block points to

entries.name: LINEINPUT
entries.purpose: echoing line input into the buffer at HL, at most B characters; $KBLINE jumps here

entries.name: ERR_OV
entries.purpose: jump here to give an OV ERROR (overflow)

entries.name: MUL10SNG
entries.purpose: multiply the single-precision accumulator by ten

entries.name: CINT
entries.purpose: convert the accumulator to an integer (BASIC CINT); where a USR routine gets its argument

entries.name: HLTOACC
entries.purpose: put the integer in HL into the accumulator; where a USR routine hands back its result

entries.name: CHKSTRING
entries.purpose: give a type mismatch error unless the accumulator holds a string

entries.name: ERR_TM
entries.purpose: jump here to give a TM ERROR (type mismatch)

entries.name: ASCTONUM
entries.purpose: read the number text at HL into the accumulator

entries.name: OUTHLDEC
entries.purpose: print the positive integer in HL in decimal on the current output device

entries.name: ERR_SN
entries.purpose: jump here to give an SN ERROR (syntax error)

entries.name: BASICERROR
entries.purpose: BASIC error exit: jump here with the error code in E

entries.name: READYALT
entries.purpose: back to BASIC Ready without a false Out of Memory: load BC with 1A18H, then jump here

entries.name: $READY
entries.purpose: jump here, do not call, to leave a machine-language program for BASIC Ready

entries.name: FIXLINEPTRS
entries.purpose: reset each line's forward pointer in the BASIC program to point at the next line (uses AF, DE, HL)

entries.name: FINDLINE
entries.purpose: find line number DE in the program: carry if found; BC at that line (or the next larger), HL just after

entries.name: INPROMPT
entries.purpose: show a question mark and a space, then read a line as KBINBUF does

entries.name: ERR_FC
entries.purpose: jump here to give an FC ERROR (illegal function call)

entries.name: ASCTODE
entries.purpose: read a positive integer (a line number, say) from the text at HL into DE; HL ends at the first non-digit

entries.name: NEWLINE
entries.purpose: start a new line unless the cursor is already at the start of one

entries.name: OUTCR
entries.purpose: send a carriage return to the current output device

entries.name: TABTO
entries.purpose: BASIC TAB for the current output device: E is the column, HL the text to show

entries.name: DEVRESETCAS
entries.purpose: select video output again, turning the cassette off if it was in use

entries.name: INPUTSTMT
entries.purpose: the BASIC INPUT statement: show the prompt, read the line, and assign the variables

entries.name: EVALEXPR
entries.purpose: evaluate the BASIC expression at HL into the accumulator

entries.name: FINDVAR
entries.purpose: locate the BASIC variable named at HL, creating it if absent; DE returns its address, as VARPTR gives it

entries.name: OUTSTR
entries.purpose: send the string at HL, ended by a zero or a quote, to the current output device (PRINT)

entries.name: ACCTODE
entries.purpose: turn the accumulator into an integer, also left in DE; Z is set if the value is from 0 to 255

entries.name: OUTSTRZ
entries.purpose: send the zero-terminated string at HL to the current output device

entries.name: BASICCSAVE
entries.purpose: BASIC CSAVE: save the program to cassette under the one-character name that HL points to

entries.name: BASICCLOAD
entries.purpose: BASIC CLOAD: load or check a program from cassette, then end at BASIC Ready

entries.name: CSHWR500
entries.purpose: write the 500-baud leader and sync byte and select the slow write routine

entries.name: CSHWR1500
entries.purpose: write the 1500-baud leader and sync byte and select the fast write routine

entries.name: CSHIN500
entries.purpose: search for the 500-baud leader and sync byte and select the slow read routine

entries.name: CSHIN1500
entries.purpose: search for the 1500-baud leader and sync byte and select the fast read routine

entries.name: CASOFF
entries.purpose: turn the cassette off; $CSOFF jumps here

entries.name: CASON
entries.purpose: turn the cassette on and blank the loading asterisks

entries.name: DISKBOOTVEC
entries.purpose: jump to the disk bootstrap routine; DISKBOOT goes through here

entries.name: COLDSTART
entries.purpose: cold-start initialization, which RST 00H continues with

entries.name: IRQHANDLER
entries.purpose: maskable interrupt handler: reads port E0H and runs the routine for the lowest set bit

entries.name: RSINITDRV
entries.purpose: address in the RS-232-C initialization control block; jumps to its driver

entries.name: RSINDRV
entries.purpose: address in the RS-232-C input control block; jumps to its driver

entries.name: RSOUTDRV
entries.purpose: address in the RS-232-C output control block; jumps to its driver

entries.name: KBDRIVER
entries.purpose: address in the keyboard control block; jumps to the keyboard driver

entries.name: ROUTEDRV
entries.purpose: address in the I/O router control block; jumps to its driver

entries.name: $DATE
entries.purpose: store the date as MO/DA/YR in the eight-byte buffer at HL

entries.name: $TIME
entries.purpose: store the time as HR:MN:SS in the eight-byte buffer at HL

entries.name: $SETCAS
entries.purpose: ask the Cass? question and set the cassette baud rate from the answer

entries.name: BREAKVEC
entries.purpose: jump vector the keyboard scan takes when BREAK is pressed; a RET at start-up

entries.name: CAPSLOCK
entries.purpose: caps lock switch: 0 for upper and lower case, nonzero for capitals only

entries.name: CURBLINK
entries.purpose: cursor blink switch: 0 blinks, nonzero holds steady

entries.name: CURADDR
entries.purpose: address of the cursor in video memory, low byte first

entries.name: CURCHAR
entries.purpose: ASCII code of the cursor character, 176 at start-up

entries.name: PRTPAGELEN
entries.purpose: printer lines per page plus one, 67 at start-up

entries.name: PRTLINECNT
entries.purpose: lines printed on the page so far, plus one

entries.name: PRTWIDTH
entries.purpose: printer maximum line length less two; 255 means no maximum

entries.name: RSRXBUF
entries.purpose: character $RSRCV received, or 0 if none

entries.name: RSTXBUF
entries.purpose: character for $RSTX to send; 0 once it has gone

entries.name: RSBAUD
entries.purpose: RS-232-C baud rate code for $RSINIT: send rate in the high nibble, receive rate in the low

entries.name: RSFORMAT
entries.purpose: RS-232-C format switches for $RSINIT: parity, word length, stop bits, transmit, DTR, RTS

entries.name: RSWAIT
entries.purpose: RS-232-C wait switch for $RSINIT: 0 does not wait, nonzero waits

entries.name: CASBAUD
entries.purpose: cassette baud rate switch: 0 is 500 baud, nonzero is 1500 baud

entries.name: SCROLLPROT
entries.purpose: number of top screen lines protected from scrolling, 0 to 7 (larger values taken modulo 8)

entries.name: TIMEDATE
entries.purpose: clock and calendar bytes: seconds, minutes, hours, year, day, month

entries.name: ROUTEDST
entries.purpose: two-letter destination device code for $ROUTE

entries.name: ROUTESRC
entries.purpose: two-letter source device code for $ROUTE
